subject: Deployment & data handling: requested clarifications and next steps
messages:
From: Asha Narayanan <asha@finanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Lee <sam@finanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: FinAnalytics kickoff: deployment & data handling notes

Marcus — thanks for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and a handful of follow-ups from our security and infra teams so we can continue qualification for a private deployment:  

1) Data residency: FinAnalytics requires all inference requests and any generated artifacts to remain in our US-east-1 tenancy. Can Redwood ensure model compute and ephemeral storage are constrained to a single region?  
2) PII handling & retention: we need default retention for request/response payloads to be configurable to 0/0 (no retention) or a maximum of 30 days; show how redaction and PII token masking would work.  
3) Logging and audit: we need tamper-evident audit logs (who called, which model version, token counts, and truncated request hash) retained for 1 year for compliance reviews.  
4) Network & egress: our compliance folks flagged the control plane egress pattern — can you provide a network boundary diagram and confirm outbound endpoints? Also: is an air-gapped / on-prem option available for advanced customers?  
5) KMS / key management: we use AWS KMS CMKs and would like to ensure request payloads can be encrypted at rest with our keys.

I've attached our initial Security PQ and a sketch of our compliance needs (FinAnalytics_Security_PQ_2026.pdf). Please respond in thread with the short answers above plus any docs or diagrams you can share. We'd like to decide whether to move to a formal technical deep-dive next week.

Thanks,
Asha Narayanan
Head of Security — FinAnalytics
asha@finanalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0183
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Narayanan <asha@finanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinAnalytics kickoff: deployment & data handling notes

Asha — great notes, thanks for the clear asks. Below are concise answers and attachments; happy to set up a technical deep-dive. (FWIW I copied the portion of your ask we referenced.)

> On 2026-10-11, Asha wrote:
> 1) Data residency: ... remain in our US-east-1 tenancy.

- Residency: Yes — for Redwood Private (VPC) we can pin inference compute to a single region and VPC. The runtime runs on your VPC subnets (private ENIs) and model artifacts are stored in your S3 within the region when using Private mode. We do not replicate artifacts to other regions unless explicitly configured.

> 2) PII handling & retention: ... configurable to 0/0 or max 30 days

- Retention: We support configurable retention policies per-customer and per-route. Options: 0 days (no request/response persistence), 7, 30 (default), or custom up to your org max. Redaction: built-in request filters can redact PII via regex-based rules and token-level masking before any persistence. We can provide a sample redaction rule set for your team to validate.

> 3) Logging and audit: ... tamper-evident audit logs retained for 1 year

- Audit logs: We emit structured audit logs (request id, model_version, token_count, truncated request hash, user_id) to your target (CloudWatch/S3/GCS). For tamper-evidence you can point logs to an append-only store (S3 + Object Lock) or route to your SIEM. Retention policies are configurable; we support 1-year retention.

> 4) Network & egress: ... control plane egress pattern

- Network boundaries: Attached is a network diagram (redwood-vpc-network-diagram-v1.png) showing (a) private control plane option (control plane hosted in your account), (b) standard managed control plane (Redwood-hosted) with a restricted list of outbound endpoints, and (c) on-prem/air-gapped option. Briefly: with the private control plane option, no outbound egress to Redwood-managed endpoints is required for inference; only optional package updates/metrics can be configured to flow out. For standard hosted control plane we provide a published list of FQDNs and IP ranges (we'll send the spreadsheet).

> 5) KMS / key management

- KMS: We support bringing your own keys (AWS KMS CMKs) for at-rest encryption of persisted artifacts. For in-memory request encryption we can implement envelope encryption and integrate with your KMS per deployment. HSM integrations are available on enterprise tiers.

Next steps I propose:
- Exchange NDA / DPA link (if needed) — Rishi, can you assist?
- Technical deep-dive: 60min with our infra and runtime leads (we'll bring network diagrams and retention flows).
- Deliverables: sample retention config, redaction ruleset, control-plane IP list, SOC2 excerpt.

I've attached the VPC network diagram and a short appendix. If this looks good, propose two slots for the deep-dive and we'll lock it in.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Asha — quick commercial / qualification notes from our side (following Marcus' answers).

> On Oct 11, Marcus wrote: "Next steps I propose: Exchange NDA / DPA link... Technical deep-dive... Deliverables: sample retention config... SOC2 excerpt."

To help scope the proposal for Private deployment please confirm the following so we can include accurate sizing/pricing in the follow-up:  
- Expected peak concurrent inference qps (approx) and typical request size (tokens in / tokens out).
- Whether FinAnalytics requires strict air-gapped on-prem (no external control plane) vs a private control plane hosted in your cloud account. These map to significantly different pricing/billing models.
- Target SLA (99.9% vs 99.95% or higher) and desired support level (Business vs Enterprise).

If you can share rough numbers here we will prepare an initial commercial sketch and bring our Dedicated/Private pricing band to the tech call. Also let us know if legal prefers a mutual NDA or if the DPA is enough to start.

Thanks — happy to coordinate times for the deep-dive; Marcus do you have Wed/Thu availability next week?

—Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Thanks Marcus and Rishi — this is helpful. Brief answers so you can scope:  
- Peak QPS: ~120 concurrent requests during spikes; average request is 600 tokens in / 300 tokens out.
- Deployment model: We prefer private control plane in our AWS account first. Air-gapped on-prem is a possibility later but would be a separate procurement path.
- SLA: aiming for 99.95% for mission-critical endpoints; enterprise support likely needed.

Legal: DPA + our standard tech addendum should be sufficient to start the deep-dive (we can exchange NDA if redwood prefers).

Deep-dive windows: Wed 2026-10-20 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 2026-10-21 14:00–15:00 PT — prefer Wed. Please confirm and send calendar invite with a dial-in and agenda. Also — please attach the SOC2 excerpt and control-plane IP spreadsheet Rishi mentioned.

I'll circulate to our infra folks once we have the invite.

Best,
Asha
Head of Security — FinAnalytics
